Explanation: Adds a combo box to a form page with the choices in the array. The name is what a screen reader says.
Adds a combo box with no choices yet.
Adds a choice to the end of the list.
Chooses the choice at an index from code and puts its text in the field. Use -1 to choose nothing.
Returns the index of the chosen choice, or -1 if nothing is chosen.
Returns the text of the chosen choice, or undefined if nothing is chosen.
Finds a combo box on a page by its name.
Sets the words shown while the field is empty.
Tells the listener each time a person picks a different choice.
The action a listener writes. The event's GetNewIndex, GetOldIndex and GetText say what changed.
